sources.label: PD 1586: Philippine Environmental Impact Statement (EIS) System
sources.description: Establishes the EIS System requiring Environmental Compliance Certificates (ECC) for projects in Environmentally Critical Areas (ECAs) and Environmentally Critical Projects (ECPs).

sources.label: DENR DAO 2003-30: Revised Procedural Manual for the EIS System
sources.description: Implements PD 1586. Defines 6 EIS stages, ECC issuance criteria, ECA/ECP classifications, and EGF requirements.

sources.label: PD 705: Revised Forestry Code of the Philippines
sources.description: Requires Tree Cutting/Transplant Permit from DENR before removing any naturally grown tree. Separate from building permit.

sources.label: RA 7586: National Integrated Protected Areas System (NIPAS) Act of 1992
sources.description: Defines NIPAS protected areas (national parks, wildlife sanctuaries, protected landscapes/seascapes, resource reserves) and PAMB-managed buffer zones.

sources.label: RA 9147: Wildlife Resources Conservation and Protection Act
sources.description: Prohibits collection, hunting, and trade of threatened Philippine wildlife. Requires Wildlife Gratuitous Permits for scientific studies.

sources.label: PD 1067: Water Code of the Philippines, Article 51 — Waterway Easements
sources.description: Establishes 3m (urban), 20m (agricultural), 40m (forest) easement from river/creek banks. No structures allowed within easement.

sources.label: RA 11038: Expanded NIPAS Act of 2018 (E-NIPAS)
sources.description: Amends RA 7586. Codifies Individual Protected Area Management Plans and PAMB authority for buffer zone determinations.

sources.label: Proclamation No. 2146 (1981): Proclamation of Environmentally Critical Areas
sources.description: Defines ECAs including watersheds, mangrove areas, coral reefs, habitats of endangered species, NIPAS areas, and steep slopes (>=50%).

sources.label: DENR DAO 2004-24: Implementing Guidelines on Tree Cutting Permits
sources.description: Implements PD 705. Details tree cutting/transplant permit application procedures.

sources.label: DENR DAO 2004-15: Coastal Zone Management Guidelines
sources.description: Provides 50-100m buffer from mangrove edge for coastal development projects.
